t: The Magnusson P20M-3Li Pocket Laser Distance Measurer offers a compact and precise solution for various measuring tasks. Ideal for tradespeople, including electricians and builders, needing fast indoor measurements for quotes or material estimates. Accurately measures distances up to 20 metres with a 3mm/m precision, and comes with an easy-to-read LCD display. The built-in automatic area and volume calculations save time, while the continuous measurement function and reference change option make complex measurements simple. The measurer can also use Pythagoras’ theorem, including both the two-point and three-point methods, to provide greater versatility. The rechargeable USB design ensures the laser measure is always ready for use, and its compact size makes it easy to carry in any toolbox.
